mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the federal funds rate above 2.5% over the prior 3 months reduces the present value of future equity cash flows, thereby depressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 2.5% in a 3-month moving average
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns show no significant negative relationship with FEDFUNDS change (p > 0.05) in the same window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) coincides with stronger consumer confidence (HOUST), amplifying earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth rate exceeds 50,000 in a month while HOUST exceeds 900
failure_condition: Multivariate Granger causality test rejects PAYEMS→SPX20d and HOUST→SPX20d at 5% significance over 60-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110 suggests weakening manufacturing demand, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO recovers above 110 within 3 days and SPX 5-day returns are positive with p < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the ratio of demand (RSAFS) to supply (INDPRO) falls below 1.1 for two consecutive months, it indicates an imbalance that precedes a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: RSAFS/INDPRO remains above 1.1 for 4 consecutive months with SPX 20-day returns all positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) below 215 triggers a risk-off reaction as investors anticipate future rate cuts, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL does not revert below 215 within 10 days and SPX 20-day returns are non-negative.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment falls below 4.5% (UNRATE) for three consecutive months, it signals a strong labor market that supports corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE remains below 4.5% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: UNRATE rises above 4.5% in the following month with SPX 60-day returns flat or negative.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of rising home sales (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) each exceeding 1,000 suggest expanding domestic demand, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: both HOUST > 1000 and INDPRO > 1100 for two consecutive months
failure_condition: Either series fails to meet threshold for 3 months while SPX 20-day returns remain negative.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply shock where the 3-month moving average of industrial production (INDPRO) declines by more than 10% from its prior peak, S&P 500 forward returns turn negative over the next 60 days as market anticipates production constraints.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO 3-month MA falls >10% from its prior maximum
failure_condition: INDPRO recovers to prior peak within 3 months with SPX 60-day returns positive.
